name: Sauerbraten (German Braised Beef Pot Roast)
reason: Literally the same dish, Sauerbraten, already in the live catalog as 'Slow Cooker Sauerbraten Bowls' (beef-chuck-roast, red-wine-vinegar, gingersnaps, onions, beef-broth): identical protein (chuck/rump roast), identical sweet-sour red-wine-vinegar braise thickened with crushed gingersnaps, identical braise method. Candidate is served as a pot roast rather than a rice bowl, but the plate is the same German braise - a near-duplicate that would embarrass the catalog.
fit_note: Published numbers 590 cal / 29.6g carb clear the 400-650 cal and <=35g carb band; low-carb braise, scalable to 14 servings, no seafood - fit is fine, but it loses on duplication.
